Read by scripts/check_provenance_census.mjs. Each `finding` is the FIRST SENTENCE of a
census finding, counts included, so the same file drifting further is a NEW finding:
· a finding NOT listed here fails the gate (nothing new joins silently);
· an entry whose finding no longer occurs fails the gate until it is removed — the
list only shrinks, and a resolved item cannot sit here inflating the count;
· an entry without an owner, a stream or an opened date fails the gate.
`weekly` is the count, one row per week, appended by the weekly report.
